capabilities: copy selected text in reading view while keeping Markdown formatting
transform links, footnotes, highlights and callouts during copy
convert selections to HTML or rich text with a custom CSS file
override the native copy hotkey and menu copy per view mode
create copy profiles with dedicated commands
extras: README lists limitations: MathJax selections are not supported, the first line of blockquotes/lists/callouts may not copy as HTML correctly, and selecting text containing an image copies only the image name. Settings changes require an Obsidian reload.
intentEvidence: The goal is to replace the native copy function of Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian's native copy outputs Obsidian-specific formatting (wikilinks, non-standard footnotes and callouts) or raw Markdown that breaks when pasted into other Markdown apps.
summary: Copy tool that copies selections as clean Markdown or rich text, rewriting links, footnotes and callouts for pasting into other software.
